summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K attaching its Third Amended and Restated Equity Incentive Plan, effective May 1, 2026. The plan is a routine compensation governance document authorizing grants of options, deferred share units, and restricted share rights to employees and directors. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard current report by a foreign private issuer relating to internal equity plan amendments, not a special situation event. No deal terms, premiums, or expected close dates are applicable. This is a routine filing with zero special-situation content.
